rules: Address the player as tú, never usted or vosotros.
Use words that work in both Spain and Latin America: teléfono (not móvil or celular), mantén presionado, escribe (not introduce or ingresa).
Strings with {{amount}} have no plural forms. Phrase them so they read for any number, e.g. "Sumar {{amount}} a las vidas".

terms.life (Magic, Flesh and Blood, or no game: vidas. Heading: Vidas. Counted: 1 vida, 20 vidas; ganar/perder vidas; total de vidas. Never "20 de vida".
terms.Yu-Gi-Oh! deck sections: Deck Principal, Deck Extra, Side Deck. A Yu-Gi-Oh! deck is Deck, never mazo.
terms.Pokémon Prize cards: cartas de Premio, capital P (1 carta de Premio)
terms.Pokémon Knocked Out: Fuera de Combate (quedar / dejar Fuera de Combate). Never derrotado or derrota.
terms.Lorcana lore: leyenda. A counted amount is puntos de leyenda (20 puntos de leyenda, 1 punto de leyenda).
terms.best of N: al mejor de N (un encuentro al mejor de 3)
terms.win / loss / draw: Victoria / Derrota / Empate; one-letter badges V / D / E
terms.host (the player): anfitrión; to host a game or lobby: crear

terms.life (Magic, Flesh and Blood, or no game: points de vie. Heading: Points de vie. Counted: 1 point de vie, 20 points de vie. Never "20 de vie".
terms.Yu-Gi-Oh! deck sections: Main Deck, Extra Deck, Side Deck (untranslated)
terms.Pokémon Prize cards: cartes Récompense (Récompense is capitalized and invariable: 2 cartes Récompense; short form Récompenses)
terms.Lorcana lore: Lore. A counted amount is éclats de Lore (1 éclat de Lore, 20 éclats de Lore).
terms.draw: Égalité for one game; match nul for a whole match
terms.abandon (ends it for everyone): a game: terminer sans résultat (status: annulée); a lobby: dissoudre le salon. Never Annuler, which is Cancel.
terms.sign in: se connecter (noun: connexion). Joining a game is rejoindre, and connecting to one is connexion en cours…; never a bare Connexion for those.

rules: Address the player with आप forms.
Game terms are the English words written in Devanagari, the way Indian players say them. Never leave a game term in Latin script; only brand names, format names and Pokémon stay Latin.

Spelling: nukta on फ़ and ज़ in English loanwords (लाइफ़, फ़ॉर्मैट), never on क, ख, ग. Chandrabindu in एँ endings (जाएँ, हटाएँ). ॉ for the English "o" in draw, toss, lobby (ड्रॉ, टॉस, लॉबी); ै for the "a" in damage (डैमेज).
Gender: लाइफ़, सीट, लॉबी and सेटिंग are feminine; लाइफ़ पॉइंट, प्राइज़ कार्ड, डैमेज, लोर, गेम, मैच, खाता and डिवाइस are masculine.

terms.win / loss / draw badges: W / L / D, in Latin script
terms.abandon (button, ends it for everyone): a game: बिना नतीजे खत्म करें; a lobby: लॉबी बंद करें

rules: Messages use です/ます. Buttons and labels use plain verbs or nouns.

Write format names in the publishers' katakana: コマンダー, スタンダード, パイオニア, モダン, レガシー, ヴィンテージ, パウパー, ブロール, リミテッド, ラッシュデュエル, クラシック, ブリッツ, シルバーエイジ, リビングレジェンド, アルティメット・ピットファイト, コア. Keep any other format name in English.
The Pokémon card noun is ポケモン; keep Pokémon in Latin only for the brand (Pokémon TCG).

terms.Yu-Gi-Oh! Life Points: ライフポイント (LP in tight labels)
terms.Yu-Gi-Oh! deck sections: メインデッキ / エクストラデッキ / サイドデッキ
terms.Pokémon Prize cards: サイド (never サイドカード; counted サイド{{count}}枚)
terms.Bench: ベンチ / ベンチポケモン
terms.commander damage: 統率者ダメージ (never コマンダーダメージ)
terms.win / loss / draw: 勝ち / 負け / 引き分け; badges 勝 / 敗 / 分
terms.abandon (ends it for everyone): a game: 中止; a lobby: 解散
terms.nearby: 近く (Android setting: 付近のデバイス). Never ニアバイ.
terms.sign in / sign out: サインイン / サインアウト

rules: Statements use 합니다체, instructions -하세요, confirmations -할까요?. Never 해요체.
Write Magic format names as Wizards Korea does: 커맨더, 스탠다드, 파이어니어, 모던, 레거시, 빈티지, 파우퍼, 난투 (Brawl). Keep other formats in English.
The Pokémon card noun is 포켓몬 (배틀 포켓몬); keep Pokémon in Latin only for the brand (Pokémon TCG).

terms.Yu-Gi-Oh! deck sections: 메인 덱 / 엑스트라 덱 / 사이드 덱
terms.win / loss / draw: 승리 / 패배 / 무승부; badges 승 / 패 / 무
terms.abandon (ends it for everyone): a game: 중단; a lobby: 로비 닫기
